description: Average fare actually paid on a US domestic route from the U.S. DOT Consumer Airfare Report (public domain, quarterly): latest {avg_fare_each_way, passengers_per_day, largest_carrier, lowest_fare_carrier}, year_over_year, lower_fare_carrier, seasonality {cheapest_quarter, priciest_quarter}, nearby_airports {options[], cheapest_alternative} (e.g. MIA vs FLL, JFK vs LGA vs EWR), history[]. Benchmark, not a live quote; ~5–6 month lag. $0.002/call. Use before booking or quoting a US domestic flight: what people actually paid on that route, the cheaper nearby airport and carrier, and the cheapest season.
name: airfare_benchmark
title: US airfare benchmark (DOT)
